svg.text: Altair: in-game orrery markers versus calculated positions
Blue rings: measured game markers. Crosses / curves: model after fitting camera only. Units below are original screenshot pixels.
Production uses the actual true-distance scenePosition path. Experimental correction is research-only. No galactic alignment enters these fits.
View 1 grey points: manually sampled game orbit outlines, excluded from all fits. Two full-system views and marker holdouts constrain the comparison.
